description: Broadcast the buyer's signed USDC.permit on-chain to set the allowance (moves NO funds; wallet pays gas). Needs the LOCAL seller wallet key + Base ETH. Broadcasting requires confirm: true. Pass tx_hash alone to record an already-broadcast permit (recovery, record-only, no confirm needed).

confirm.description: Required true to BROADCAST the buyer's signed USDC.permit on-chain (gas only, moves no funds).

subscription_id.description: Subscription id from the permit collectable bag.

tx_hash.description: Recovery only: an ALREADY-broadcast permit tx hash to record — skips any broadcast (and needs no confirm; the record is idempotent).

name: xenarch_permit_submit
